description: Book a spa/massage-style SERVICE slot on behalf of a real guest — check_service_availability shows free slots; the venue's city/countryCode come from search_venues. Unlike book_room this is an INSTANT confirmation (a real slot is atomically reserved). No payment is collected by this tool — the guest pays at the venue.

practitionerId.description: Optional: a specific person from check_service_availability's availablePractitioners. Omit for whoever is free.
